t: A request that was not granted
a: اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَبِّي أَنْ أَسْتَغْفِرَ لأُمِّي فَلَمْ يَأْذَنْ لِي وَاسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ أَنْ أَزُورَ قَبْرَهَا فَأَذِنَ لِي
m: I sought permission to ask forgiveness for my mother and He did not permit me. I sought permission to visit her grave and He permitted me.
